description: One-direction BYOL cosine loss per paper Section 3.1, Equation (2): squared distance between row-wise L2-normalized predictions and detached targets. The caller computes the swapped-view term for the full symmetric objective in Equation (3).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def paired_views(ctx):
    view = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    target = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(view), "targets": synth.Tensor(target)}
ds = synth.Spec("byol-views", generator=paired_views, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=4)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "byol-loss"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a predictor with BYOL cosine loss

name: BYOL cosine loss

parameters.ignore_index: must be None because embedding vectors are not indexed classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point prediction tensor with shape [B, D], where B and D are at least 1
parameters.reduction: none per example, mean, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor with the same shape, dtype, and device as prediction; detached inside the loss
